title: Goldfish reading a book

  <line x1='76' y1='53' x2='86' y2='50' stroke='#bdbdbd' stroke-width='1.6'/>
  <line x1='76' y1='58' x2='86' y2='55' stroke='#bdbdbd' stroke-width='1.6'/>
